Creator: John VI Kantakouzenos, emperor and later the monk Joasaph; Greek text edited, with Latin translation, by Ludwig Schopen

Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; the OCR text follows it unchanged. Nothing was stripped, normalised, corrected, re-spaced or retyped (the long s glyph occurs 0 times and was left as found). The Google Books boilerplate page at the head of the OCR is left in place. The OCR text that follows is 2201734 bytes, 1697848 characters and 41031 lines. OCR quality sampled at the title pages and at about 5%, 50% and 95% of the file (lines 2064, 20528 and 38992): Latin clean; Greek polytonic readable with occasional slips.
Content note: Volume 3 of the Bonn edition: Book IV (1347-1356), the years of the synod of 1351 that made the Palamite position the church's standard, the quarrel over the crown and Kantakouzenos's abdication. Palamas and the Barlaamite controversy are named throughout. Greek above, Latin below; the volume ends with indices.

nunc ultro apud animum proposuisti, etiam opere ipso explere vo-

amici germani liberis, tanquam pro suismet, decertans: et tu reli-

propter hanc animi altitudinem omnes te admiratione et praedica- 
tione afficient. Hoc insuper consequere, ut omnes eius cognati sin- 
gulares tibi gratias agant et velut insolubili amicitiae nodo eum tibi 
adstringes, ut totius aevi sui curriculo necesse habeat, nihil, quod 
ad dignitatem et commodum tuum pertineat, negligere. Ut igitur 
eximiis quibusdam bonis magnitudinem animi declaraturus , ne 
verbis tantummodo velis, sed bene consulta ad opus conferre, ne 
procrastina."
